name: turn_retrieval_cpu_v1
population: All40 completed collection episodes and every actual rollout request start, full category and success/failure strata. No selected cases or resampling.
input_rule: Align actual parsed action prefixes with saved executed actions/positions. Nonfinal turns consume valid prefix before first unsupported action; final turn may stop on observed terminal. Any mismatch is unknown, retains denominator. No environment steps, new action simulation or lost tensor reconstruction.
fixed_retrieval: Read-only original5 cards, existing provider.retrieve+directional guard and min_score0.8; no threshold/library/feature changes. Only states at actual model decision starts count.
candidate_gap: Current agent retrieves/injects only before initial observation; _handle_env_state appends new observations without another retrieve/inject. No algorithm change in this CPU screen.

gate_before_new_GPU_discussion.if_below: Close dynamic-retrieval candidate without GPU or threshold/seed search.

scientific_scope: Posthoc mechanism opportunity census, not efficacy evidence or independent validation. Original40 outcomes known.
publication: Code/config and full parameter-free state/retrieval result only. Protect input containers and all prior models.
